decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an early interval (365–484) with complex, non-smooth cross-axis behavior including multi-sample shifts and ambiguous partial returns; (2) a sharp, coherent multi-axis jump at index 485, followed by sustained high-amplitude motion. No other intervals show similarly compelling morphology.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a prolonged, irregular drift with intermittent spikes in N/E/U; no clear platform but several multi-sample shifts (e.g. around index 390–395 and 420–425) suggest possible superposed temporary offsets or opposing returns. The motion is noisy but not monotonic—some apparent reversals in E and U without full recovery.

Abrupt large-magnitude jump occurs between indices 484 and 485: N jumps from ~-2.9 to ~11.6, E from ~-4.3 to ~-17.2, U from ~2.2 to ~-13.0 — a coherent, near-instantaneous offset across all axes. Following this, the series remains at elevated amplitude with persistent oscillation, suggesting a permanent shift with residual motion. The jump is unambiguous and warrants close inspection.
